t: This is the College of Arms, the heraldic authority for England, Wales, Northern Ireland and some Commonwealth realms. Its officers act for the Crown on coats of arms, family pedigrees and the flying of flags, and they help plan ceremonies such as coronations and state funerals. The College was founded by Richard III, and Mary I and Philip II of Spain are also named as founders. Several officers of arms died here, including Isaac Heard, who served as Garter Principal King of Arms and officiated at royal funerals.
